notes: Two PCs behind one shop router can now reach each other: every device picks its own UDP port instead of all of them using 51820, prefers a peer's LAN address when they are on the same network, and leaves a port its router will not carry. The Windows agent is a Windows program — listed in Settings so it uninstalls like any other app, silent install with /S /CODE=, an MSI for deployment tools, a notification-area icon showing whether it works, and a refusal to downgrade itself. It survives a reboot, and now notices a resume and a network change instead of waiting out a keepalive. The device page answers "has it restarted?" and "what went wrong last?", and has an Update now button. One link, with the join code in it, is all a customer needs to be sent. One click shares a computer's LAN. The edge keeps itself current by default, and critical alerts reach a telephone.
